summary: Derived 102 pull requests from the ten source files, 77 strong and 25 conservative, and wrote the committed targets/reservations.json. Every bare number resolved to the nearest repository its scope names - a register's own on every line of the register - and owner and repository names were folded to one spelling before entries were merged, as the forge compares them.
establishes: That the reservation set is reproducible from the repository by a retained run, and that its written rule describes the derivation it records.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
